title: Mayview Music
description: BigChadGuys Plus, Vol. 2 (OST) and Mayview (OST) as music discs!
body:
A simple mod that introduces all the amazing songs composed for BigChadGuys Plus and Mayview by [@bndf88](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3g17Z2B27k2RogCyjtunpV).

BigChadGuys Plus Vol. 2:
- Waltz for the Lilies
- Voyagers
- Blessings
- Beginning of Infinity
- Planes in Space
- Joe Theme
- Departure
- Arrival

Mayview:
- Mayview Theme
- Jungle
- Improvisation

Support the artist by streaming his music on your favorite platforms!

- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/album/2pf8MuPrXg6uWz13TnIxbA)
- [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/album/bigchadguys-plus-vol-2-original-game-soundtrack/1765066036)
